name: Holodnye ob'jatija
source:
This story tells how the protagonist Dima and his friend, Grisha, came to the pioneer camp "Sovenok".
In the pioneer camp, Dima meets completely new characters, all of whom he will get to know closely in this entirely new camp shift.
Initially, he does not have a good relationship with some of those characters, but through your actions, he could establish a real connection with them.
